clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery DAP; standard lead time 21 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

persona.summary: Family sheet-metal shop (70 staff, EUR 7.5 M). We are 11.3 % of its turnover; it is our sole source for base frame HN 50/65 (our tooling, no second source). Quality is collapsing: red scorecard three quarters running, OTD 63 %, 4118 ppm, escalation letter sent 24 Sep. It asked +2-4 % in 2024/25 and settled at 0. Open deep, lead with scorecard and cost recovery, then index and forecast.
persona.notes: Needs our volume (11 % of turnover); asked for 10-day payment against a cash discount (generic e-mail, no distress: credit index flat 232). Fears losing the frame after the red escalation. No should-cost and no second source: our walk-away rests on owning the tooling. We pay 6 days late on average, no complaint yet.
fears: losing the frame after the red escalation

evidence.quote: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.
47.4 % of invoices paid over 5 days late

levers: 10-day payment only against cash discount or price cut
arguments: complaint cost recovery under clause 6.1 and escalation doc:20260924-70310-P12
material/energy index, only if it actually fell
notice-period breach: any 2027 increase missed the 90-day deadline
avoid: citing a cost driver that rose
giving faster payment for free: it is not distressed
tactics: Open deep and lead with the red scorecard and the escalation letter: quality cost recovery is the first argument.
Use our 11 % share of its turnover: it cannot afford to lose the frame.
Offer 10-day payment only if it comes with a cash discount or extra price cut.
Add index and forecast arguments one kind per round; move in small visible steps.
Reject any increase: the 90-day notice before year end has passed.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history shows it asks +2-4 % and settles at 0, and once gave -6 % after asking -2.2 %, so it yields under pressure.
